g.text: 1 SW_A / SW_B boxes: compact switching-node corridor; keep quiet traces out.

g.desc: 1 SW_A / SW_B boxes: compact switching-node corridor; keep quiet traces out.

g.text: 2 Suggested L2 void: only under final SW copper footprint. Do not cut return paths.

g.desc: 2 Suggested L2 void: only under final SW copper footprint. Do not cut return paths.

g.text: 3 Tall boxes beside MOSFETs: local PVDD HF loop. C100n nearest, then C1u / C10u.

g.desc: 3 Tall boxes beside MOSFETs: local PVDD HF loop. C100n nearest, then C1u / C10u.

g.text: 4 Driver boxes: HO/HS and LO/VSS gate loops. Reserve separate Kelvin source returns.

g.desc: 4 Driver boxes: HO/HS and LO/VSS gate loops. Reserve separate Kelvin source returns.

g.text: 5 L2: continuous GND reference elsewhere; no analogue/digital plane split.

g.desc: 5 L2: continuous GND reference elsewhere; no analogue/digital plane split.

g.text: 6 L3: symmetric +24 V feeds from central bulk, via lower band into local PVDD caps.

g.desc: 6 L3: symmetric +24 V feeds from central bulk, via lower band into local PVDD caps.

g.text: 7 Keep both speaker terminals floating from GND. Zobel / C330n are after inductors.

g.desc: 7 Keep both speaker terminals floating from GND. Zobel / C330n are after inductors.

g.text: 8 Central box: U11 +12V_GD / U12 +5V_A thermal area; verify package and exposed pads.

g.desc: 8 Central box: U11 +12V_GD / U12 +5V_A thermal area; verify package and exposed pads.

g.text: 9 Translated power cells preserve MOSFET/driver orientation; routing is not validated.

g.desc: 9 Translated power cells preserve MOSFET/driver orientation; routing is not validated.

g.text: 10 Existing tracks / vias / pours omitted in this COPY only. Production PCB unchanged.

g.desc: 10 Existing tracks / vias / pours omitted in this COPY only. Production PCB unchanged.
